messages:
rachel: Quick idea 9— 20-min micro-demo + 48h credit drip to shorten TTFS. Split test two onboarding flows: 'rapid' vs 'guided'. Goal: faster first prompt run and higher 48h activation.
diego: Nice. Rapid = product-first prompts + one-click sample. Guided = use-case stories + hand-holding templates.
evan_marketing: Metrics to track: time_to_first_prompt, activated_48h, demo->paid_30d. I'll set utm=funnel_rapid|funnel_guided.
sarah_sdr: Routing: company emails + >500 tokens in 7d -> high-priority SDR queue. Otherwise automated nurture. SLA first touch <=6h.
ops-bot: Routing rule created. Example webhook: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/route -d '{"utm":"funnel_rapid","assign":"cohort_rapid"}'
rachel: Copy drafts: Rapid post: 'Get a working LLM demo in 20 minutes + 48h credits.' Guided post: 'See customer playbooks + starter credits.' CTAs: 'Try demo' vs 'See playbook + credits'.
diego: Landing needs one-click sample app + hidden field use_case. Also add tiny success survey: "Did you get expected output?" yes/no.
evan_marketing: I'll create two landing variants, wire utm, and add microsurvey. Will post copy in thread.
sarah_sdr: SDR script: quick intro + offer 30-min workshop, remind credits expire. Template ready.
ops-bot: Tracking snippet for credit grant: <script>emit('credit_grant',{cohort:'rapid',amount:2000});</script> Include after signup.
rachel: Onboarding artifact: 3 micro-templates per funnel. Rapid pack = minimal prompts. Guided pack = examples + notes. Add to /docs/mini-demo/pack-1799999991.md
evan_marketing: Timeline: creatives + landing by Fri EOD, routing live Mon, demo Tue. Who presents the 20-min demo?
diego: I can demo retrieval + cost points. rachel will cover prompts.
rachel: Will post final copy here. Ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
